about: Lead the revolution with an army of flamethrowing Boars, mustard gas-lobbing Skunks, and paratrooper-puking Owls. Tooth and Tail is a Real-Time-Strategy game featuring Single Player, Online Competitive Play, Split Screen, Replays, and more.
Build a base, lead your army, eat your enemies!
The War for Meat -- The Longcoats, the Commonfolk, the KSR, and the Civilized are in the midst of a Civil War over who gets to eat, and who has to be the meat.
A darkly humorous tale of riots and revolution is told through an extensive Single Player campaign.
Endless Replayability -- With procedurally generated maps and customizable factions, no two conflicts will be the same, forcing players to strategize rather than memorize.

Pick-up-and-Play -- With matches lasting from 5-12 minutes, controls designed specifically for the DUALSHOCK®4, and split-screen couch play, Tooth and Tail is a popcorn RTS for veterans and newcomers alike.
